newsitem.title: PANAMA: Panama 1997 budget sees $434 mln in foreign loans.
newsitem.headline: Panama 1997 budget sees $434 mln in foreign loans.

text.p: Panama expects to receive some $434 million in multilateral and bilateral loans next year, according to the official gazette published Friday which records all government legislation.

Panama's $4.728 billion 1997 budget, approved by Congress on Monday, foresees credits totaling $180 million from the Inter-American Development Bank (IADB), $77 million from the World Bank and $17 million from the International Monetary Fund, according to the document.
A further $60 million in credits are expected from Taiwan, $50 million from China, $25 million from Japan, and $12.8 million from Spain.
